\paragraph{Real-model telemetry audit.}
The bounded audit completed 30 orchestration events using 156 API calls without retries. The requested GPT-4o alias resolved to \texttt{gpt-4o-2024-08-06}. The calls consumed 77546 input and 3697 output tokens, corresponding to an estimated standard API cost of \$0.2308 at the recorded prices. Mean wall time was 3489.2~ms per AAI-CDOS event and 1466.4~ms per One-Shot event.
At 50 vehicles, 3 of 10 sampled states had no deadline-feasible candidate even after the minimum-latency fallback; these events exhausted the three-round verifier budget. This small sampled audit is reported only as planner telemetry and is not used to form the network-performance confidence intervals.
Because the measured cloud-API planner wall time exceeds the 0.15--1.0~s application deadlines, the audit does not support synchronous per-event cloud control. A deployment interpretation requires asynchronous or precomputed orchestration, or a substantially lower-latency local serving path.
